name: Dirigible Expert
description:
You know how to build, operate and repair lighter-than-air-craft.

Whenever you roll to operate or repair an air vessel, +2d.

Additionally, if you have access to the necessary materials, you can construct an air vessel. It takes one day per passenger capacity to build, costs you 1 Endurance per hour per passenger to keep aloft, and has a cruising speed of 5 miles per hour times the number of ranks you have in Craft.

Describe the work, the finished product and how you operate the craft.
